scenario: Schema declarations are part of a library's importable surface per LIMP.7.2. Pin: a library declares one schema; the rules-file selectively imports it; the rule pattern matches the imported schema. compile_ok proves the schema flows through the import-resolution layer cleanly.
rules_ds:
from ha import Light

rule r:
    Light l where l.is_on == true
->
    log info "x"

libraries.ha:
schema Light scope logical:
    is_on: Bool key
